questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the excess noise? You state three measured and show four data sets from them (p. 8, p. 16); how many were fabricated or cooled down in all?
Why were the others set aside? If any device or cooldown did not reach a usable 5/2 state or stable QPCs, a line saying so would help.

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: the magnetic field position within the 5/2 plateau, the QPC gate settings and reflection values, temperatures above 10 mK, and bias beyond e*V_S/2k_BT of about 6?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like? Your Figs. S1 to S3 answer this for devices A, B and C; thank you for including them.

How did you choose the field and QPC settings for each data set, and why does Fig. 2b come from data set 4 and Fig. 3b from data set 3? Does the cross-validation in your Outlook hold within a single data set?

What experimental uncertainty sits behind "within experimental uncertainty" (p. 7), and could you add error bars to the Fano factors, especially where F_neutral in Figs. S1h and S4h lies above both predictions? Does "the A-Pf prediction lies closer to the measured values" (p. 17) mean closer to the PH-Pf curve?

Fig. 2b shows the trivial baseline F_charge = 1; could Fig. 3b show the matching ordinary baseline (trivial partitioning alone, or the heating model of Fig. S9) for data set 3, and have you run the heating model on data sets 1 to 3 and on the charged configuration?
Does the bias dependence of R_QPC in Figs. S1 to S4 (a, e) agree with the scaling dimensions you use, and how strongly could the ν = 1/2 channel couple to the outer integer channels over 1.4 µm?
